citation.title: Adipose tissue transcriptomics and epigenomics in low birthweight men and controls: role of high-fat overfeeding and effects of fasting

population.description: The 8 normal-birth-weight (NBW) men of Table 1, who took part in both the 36 h fast and the control study; healthy young Danish men born at term (week 39-41), recruited from the Danish National Birth Register, age- and BMI-matched to the LBW men. Age: the paper gives only 'Healthy, young (22-27 years)' for the recruited men (a design statement, not an observed range of these 8) and nothing else on age, so 22-27 is used as min and max. BMI: Table 1 control-study column, 23.5 +/- 4.0 kg/m2 (fasting column 23.7 +/- 4.1); exclusion BMI > 30. The low-birth-weight (LBW) men of Table 1 are also healthy, matched for age and BMI, but a group the model cannot tell apart by birth weight, and no pooled LBW+NBW Table 1 values are printed: the NBW men, the term-born reference group, are the one group entered.

protocols.name: nbw_control_12h
protocols.description: Control study: standardized meals on day 1 (breakfast 8:00, lunch 12:00, snack 15:00, dinner 19:30), then an overnight fast; biopsies 07:00-07:30 on the second day, which the paper calls 12 h of fasting (19:30 + 12 h = 07:30); the glucose, insulin and FFA values were obtained 1 h after the biopsy (Table 1 footnote). Arithmetic: sample 08:00-08:30, midpoint 08:15, is 12 h 45 min after the 19:30 dinner, so prefast_hours 12.75 rather than the printed 12 (which is the time of the biopsy); start_hour 7.75 puts minute 29.5 of the 30 min run-in at 08:15. Neither the sampling clock time nor the arm length is printed, so start_hour, prefast_hours (derived) and duration_min are assumed. The paper also says an IVGTT was started shortly after the biopsies; the printed levels are fasting levels and are read as the basal sample. Water only; no meals.

protocols.name: nbw_fast_36h
protocols.description: Fasting study: standardized meal at 19:30 on arrival, fasted thereafter (water ad libitum; smokers allowed a 10 mg Nicorette inhaler, number of smokers not printed); biopsies 07:00-07:30 on the morning the paper calls 36 h of fasting (19:30 + 36 h = 07:30 two mornings later); the values were obtained 1 h after the biopsy (Table 1 footnote). Arithmetic: sample 08:00-08:30, midpoint 08:15, is 36 h 45 min after the 19:30 meal, so prefast_hours 36.75 rather than the printed 36; start_hour 7.75 puts minute 29.5 of the 30 min run-in at 08:15. Start hour, derived prefast_hours and arm length are assumed. Two 10-min sessions on an ergometer bicycle on the first day 'to avoid inactivity': no intensity and no clock time printed, so they cannot be entered as activity; 20 min of exercise of unstated intensity, about a day before the sample, in a 36 h fast, is noted and not entered. The paper also says an IVGTT was started shortly after the biopsies; the printed levels are fasting levels and are read as the basal sample.

left_out.what: The same Table 1 values for the low-birth-weight (LBW) group, n = 8 (glucose, insulin, FFA, HOMA-IR, lipids), both conditions: a group set apart by birth weight, which the model cannot be told, and the paper gives no pooled LBW+NBW values in the text
HOMA-IR, both groups and conditions (Table 1; calculated from minimal modelling)
Total and HDL cholesterol, both groups and conditions (Table 1)

Energy expenditure, respiratory quotient, glucose and fat oxidation (Table 1; footnote a: 6 NBW men): the control values were measured 'at baseline' with no fasting hours or clock time printed; the fasting-study values 'after 34 h of fasting' in a 30 min indirect calorimetry (the Methods say 'after 31 h and 34 h of fasting'), clock time not printed
Weight, body fat % and waist-hip ratio (Table 1)
Full-cohort (20 LBW vs 17 NBW) glucose, insulin, FFA after 36 h fasting are in Table S1, a supplementary table not in the full text supplied; the text gives no numbers for them

Hourly overnight blood sampling and the 180-min IVGTT after the biopsies, and the adipose and muscle expression and methylation results: described in the methods, with no values printed in the text or tables
Two 10-min ergometer bicycle sessions on the first day of the fast, 'to avoid inactivity' (Methods): intensity and clock time not printed
